hero_kpi_rationale: Backlog is the primary growth indicator for a construction company, reflecting revenue visibility at 2-3 years out, especially in the emerging markets where Mota-Engil operates.

kpis.name: Order backlog
kpis.explanation: Total value of signed contracts not yet executed.
kpis.description: Backlog reached 13.7 billion euros at mid-2024, up 6% from year start.
kpis.signal: Backlog up 6% at year start, sign of solid visibility.

kpis.name: Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated from sales and service delivery.
kpis.description: Revenue reached 2.732 billion euros in 1H24, up 7% versus prior year.
kpis.signal: Revenue growth of 7%, new record at mid-year.

kpis.name: EBITDA
kpis.explanation: Operating result before depreciation and amortization.
kpis.description: EBITDA reached 396 million euros in 1H24, representing a 15% margin, up from 14% prior year.

kpis.name: Operating margin
kpis.description: Operating margin (EBIT) improved to 8.7% in 1H24 from 8.3% in 1H23.

kpis.name: Capital expenditure
kpis.explanation: Spending on physical or technology assets for growth.
kpis.description: CAPEX amounted to 309 million euros, with 80% financed by medium to long-term contracts.
kpis.signal: 80% of CAPEX linked to growth contracts.

kpis.name: Net debt
kpis.description: Net debt was 1.268 billion euros, with net debt to EBITDA ratio of 1.4x.
kpis.signal: Net debt to EBITDA ratio at 1.4x, healthy level.

kpis.name: Shareholders' equity
kpis.explanation: Consolidated shareholders' equity of the group.
kpis.description: Shareholders' equity reached 744 million euros, up 239 million over one year.

kpis.name: Revenue share: Latin America
kpis.explanation: Proportion of revenue generated in Latin America.
kpis.description: Latin America represented 54% of revenue in 1H24, versus 52% in 1H23.
kpis.signal: Growing weight of Latin America in revenue mix.

kpis.name: Engineering and Construction contribution to revenue
kpis.explanation: Share of revenue from engineering and construction activities.
kpis.description: E&C activities represented 82% of total revenue in 1H24.

risks.title: Shareholder concentration and governance risk
risks.score_rationale: Major risk identified in Item 1A: 72.58% of capital held by two shareholders (Mota Gestão 40.17% + Epoch/CCCC 32.41%). Neutral language but concentrated shareholder structure creates control risk. Trend stable but structural weight high for construction group.

risks.title: Dependence on Chinese shareholder CCCC
risks.score_rationale: Epoch Capital (33.07% of voting rights) is attributable to China Communications Construction Group. Item 1A position reveals significant geopolitical exposure. Sino-Western trade tensions and rising regulations on Chinese investments. Category weight high for group operating in Europe/Africa.

risks.title: Related-party conflicts of interest risk (Mota family)
risks.score_rationale: Mota family holds 40.17% via MGP plus key positions (CEO, CFO, Deputy CEO). Multiple internal transactions detailed (stock purchases April-June 2024). Neutral language but family structure creates non-arm's length transaction risks. Trend stable but governance weight high.

risks.title: Exposure to currency and emerging market risks
risks.score_rationale: Group operates in Africa, Asia, Europe with multi-currency revenues (USD, AUD, ZAR, etc.). Item 1A does not detail currency hedges. Emerging market volatility impacts long-term contract margins. Trend up with geopolitical tensions. Weight moderate but specific to operational model.

risks.title: Dependence on public contracts and regulatory environment
risks.score_rationale: Mota-Engil is major constructor dependent on public contracts (roads, ports, infrastructure). Rising regulatory environment (ESG, environment, labor). Item 1A mentions regulatory risks. Language moderate but weight high for construction sector. Trend up with tightening standards.

risks.title: Project cost overrun and budget variance risks
risks.score_rationale: Construction sector exposed to budget overrun risks (materials, labor, delays). Item 1A implicit: fixed-price long-term contracts vulnerable to inflation. Neutral language but major operational risk. Trend up post-COVID (material inflation, shortages). Weight high for profitability.

risks.title: Cybersecurity and digitalization of operations
risks.score_rationale: Item 1A does not explicitly mention cybersecurity. Group digitalizing operations (BIM, project management, supply chain). Emerging risk for construction sector. Language absent but trend up. Weight moderate for mid-size group.

risks.title: Commodity price volatility and supply chain
risks.score_rationale: Constructor depends on stable steel, cement, fuel prices. Fixed-price long-term contracts vulnerable. Item 1A implicit. Neutral language but operational risk. Trend stable post-2022 but weight high for margins. Supply chain fragile post-COVID.

ai_positioning.summary: No mention of artificial intelligence or related technologies in the documents provided. The company does not appear to position AI as a strategic lever.
evidence: No reference to AI, machine learning or advanced automation
Absence of KPIs related to digitalization or technology innovation
Focus on execution of traditional construction contracts
